The '''Old Spacers' Entertainment Hospice''' was a charity organization that the [[entertainer]] [[Keenos]] collected for after his performances in the [[Atrium]] at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. In truth, the main recipient of the Old Spacer's Entertainment Hospice was himself.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
